assessment: Luna shows a preference for wet food over dry food, which may affect her eating habits and nutrition. The owner is advised to transition foods gradually to avoid dietary upset. Luna is otherwise active and playful with no reported behavioral or health concerns. Vaccinations are current.
plan: Advise the owner to transition between wet and dry food in a delayed and graduated manner to encourage acceptance and avoid dietary issues. Continue monitoring Luna's appetite and activity levels. Maintain up-to-date vaccinations. No additional diagnostics or treatments were discussed.
